d: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Dean Curnutt, founder and CEO of Macro Risk Advisors, says the market selloff could prove “cleansing” by resetting valuations and making room for fresh capital, but warns that the growing overlap between the AI trade and the broader economy could leave markets vulnerable to further downside. Doug Rediker, managing partner at International Capital Strategy, says the market correction is helping “rationalize and normalize” the AI thesis after a period of heavy investment and rising financing…
